runs.name: mid-16-full-fraction
runs.notes: The best run on record with the thinning drawn up to the whole prediction rather than up to nine tenths of it. mid-16-views-500k took the dense end without paying for it in the mean, and the one share it still never trains on is the one validation's widest budget hands over: at six context views the field is 301,056 Gaussians and the 500k budget thins nothing at all. This is the last out-of-distribution gap at that budget.

runs.name: mid-24-views-500k
runs.notes: Is sixteen the right cap, or only better than sixty-four? Two to twenty-four views on the same ceiling, predicting up to 1,204,224 Gaussians so the thinning runs to 42%. Queued but not launched unattended.
